response.sql: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT r.driverId, SUM(r.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results AS r WHERE r.grid >= 12 AND r.points IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.driverId) SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total, AVG(avg_laps) AS average_of_average_laps FROM driver_totals;
